vulnerability_analysis: The MarvinInu contract has an automatic LP token burn feature that can be configured by the owner. When enabled, transfers to automated market maker pairs trigger autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() which burns MARVIN tokens from the LP pair to 0xdead. The owner can set burn frequency (min 600s) and burn percentage (max 10% = 1000 basis points). This allows the owner to manipulate token economics by reducing LP liquidity without LP provider consent.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank(). 2. Configure auto LP burn with minimum frequency (600s) and maximum percentage (1000 = 10%). 3. Enable trading to initialize lastLpBurnTime. 4. Warp time forward to exceed the burn frequency. 5. Transfer tokens from a non-excluded address to the AMM pair to trigger auto burn. 6. Verify the LP pair balance decreased.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get contract instance and read uniswapV2Pair address. 2. Record initial LP balance. 3. vm.prank(owner) to impersonate owner. 4. Call setAutoLPBurnSettings(600, 1000, true). 5. Call enableTrading(). 6. vm.warp(block.timestamp + 601) to pass burn frequency. 7. Transfer tokens from attacker (non-excluded) to uniswapV2Pair. 8. Assert LP balance decreased.
